report: Impressionsfraktur des lateralen Tibiaplateaus mit deutlicher Impression der Gelenkfläche mit entsprechendem Knorpeldefekt und angrenzendem Bonebruise Areal des lateralen Tibiaplateaus. Geringes Bonebruise Areal auch am medialen Tibiaplateau sowie der medialen Femurcondyle. Darüber hinaus kein weiterer Frakturnachweis an den ossären Strukturen. Initial degenerative Veränderungen. Keine höhergradige Chondropathie femoropatellar und im lateralen Kompartiment. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband sowie Kollateralbänder intakt. Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne intakt ohne Signalalteration. Horizontale Rissbildung des Innenmeniskus im Pars intermedia und Hinterhorn. Geringe Signalalterationen des Außenmeniskus, insbesondere am Vorederhorn ohne eindeutige Rissbildung. Geringer Gelenkerguss. Bakerzyste. Gering subcutane Einblutungen.

2. Tear of medial meniscus; degeneration of lateral meniscus and R/O tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus.
3. Degeneration of ACL, MCL and proximal LCL and popliteus tendon.
4. Paratendinitis along pes anserinus.
5. Synovitis and joint effusion of left knee and patellar plicae.
6. Subcutaneous edema over anterior aspect of left knee.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.

Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Intrasubstance degeneration posterior horn medial meniscus without tear. The anterior horn and body as well as posterior root are intact. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, and biceps femoris tendon insertion are intact. Mild popliteus tendinosis without tear. The iliotibial band is intact.

The TT-TG distance measures 6 mm, within normal limits. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. No patellofemoral subluxation. Mild quadriceps insertional tendinosis without tear. Mild proximal patellar tendinosis without tear.

Fissuring of articular cartilage at the patellar apex and along the lateral patellar facet with focal full thickness cartilage denuding at the periphery of the lateral patellar facet. Focal full thickness cartilage denuding lateral femoral trochlea near the central trochlea. There is a tiny focus of full-thickness cartilage denuding involving the posterior weightbearing aspect lateral tibial plateau. The remainder of the lateral femorotibial articular cartilage is relatively preserved. Preserved medial femorotibial articular cartilage. 

Small knee joint effusion. Trace fluid in the deep infrapatellar recess. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. No evidence of discrete meniscal, ligament, or tendon tear.
2. Quadriceps and popliteus tendinosis, without tears.
3. Moderate patellofemoral chondrosis consistent with moderate patellofemoral predominant osteoarthritis of the right knee.
